1.title: Video of Kirk Assassination Suspect’s Ex-Partner to Be Played in Court
1.summary: A judge said he would allow prosecutors to play the recording at a hearing on Thursday as prosecutors seek to take Tyler Robinson to trial on a charge that he murdered Charlie Kirk last year.

2.title: Police Investigating Death of Nolan Wells Who Went Missing After Boat Trip
2.summary: Nolan Wells was found dead days after going on a July 4 trip with friends to Horn Island, off the coast of Mississippi.

3.title: Does a Sex Assault Claim Kill a Political Career? It Depends.
3.summary: The swift exit of Graham Platner from the Maine Senate race followed Eric Swalwell’s similar exit from the California governor’s race, but Republicans have taken a different tack.

4.title: Trump Praises NATO’s ‘Unity’ After Lashing Out at Allies
4.summary: Though President Trump assailed partners for not joining the war in Iran, he said he would grant Ukraine long-sought authority to make the Patriot defense system.

5.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Launches New Strikes on Iran, Military Says
5.summary: U.S. Central Command said on social media that it was protecting shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump said earlier that he thought a three-week-old cease-fire was “over.”

6.title: As More Remains Are Found in Rubble From Venezuela Earthquakes, Horror Becomes Routine
6.summary: Fearful that officials would tear down damaged buildings without accounting for any remaining bodies, Venezuelans are desperately digging for their relatives’ remains.
